ratings.title: Ratings moderation
ratings.description: Review reported rating comments. Hiding a comment keeps the score; voiding removes the whole rating from every score.
ratings.void_reason_required: Enter a reason for voiding this rating.
ratings.hide_explain: The comment will be hidden from everyone. The scores keep counting.
ratings.restore_explain: The comment will be visible again.
ratings.void_explain: Voiding is permanent: this rating will stop counting toward the worker's reliability score, rating average, employer reputation and KPIs.

org_ratings.title: What workers say
org_ratings.description: Ratings and comments workers left about working with you.
org_ratings.anonymous_explain: Ratings are anonymous: we don't show who wrote them or the exact date, only the month. They appear only once at least {min} workers have rated you, so no single worker can be identified.
org_ratings.empty_title: No worker ratings to show yet
org_ratings.below_threshold: {count, plural, =0 {No workers have rated you yet.} one {# worker has rated you so far.} other {# workers have rated you so far.}} Ratings are shown once there are at least {min}.
org_ratings.empty_body: Ratings will appear here when workers rate you.
org_ratings.comment_hidden: This comment was hidden by KaamSathi moderators.
org_ratings.flagged_hint: Reported. It stays visible until KaamSathi reviews it.
org_ratings.report_description: KaamSathi will review it and may hide it if it breaks the rules. The rating's scores still count.
org_ratings.reason_hint: For example: abusive language, personal details, or not about working here.

resubmission.badge_hint: The worker re-submitted this after an earlier rejection.
